title: Deduce

inlines.v: DEDUCE, verb transitive [Latin To lead, bring or draw.] 1. To draw from; to bring from. O goddess, say, shall I deduce my rhymes From the dire nation in its early times? 2. To draw from, in reasoning; to gather a truth, opinion or proposition from premises; to infer something from what precedes. Reasoning is nothing but the faculty of deducing unknown truths from principles already known. 3. To deduct. 4. To transplant.
